column1: Make a pivot with Discount in Rows and Profit in Values. At what discount does profit first turn negative, and how much money is lost from all the lines above 40%?
Which Furniture sub-category loses money, and how much? Then filter to that sub-category and look at Discount in Rows. Where does the loss come from?
Make a pivot with Region in Rows and Category in Columns, using Profit in Values. Which one box is negative, and what would you tell that region’s manager?
Make a pivot with Order Year in Rows, and Sales and Profit in Values. Which year did sales fall? Is the manager right that “profit isn’t growing as fast as sales”? Use growth % to prove it.
Make a pivot with Customer Name in Rows, and Sales and Profit in Values. Name the 3 customers who lose the most money. How many of the 793 customers have negative profit in total?
